--- pipe_limit_minimal.sql
FROM t |> LIMIT 1

--- AST
&ast.QueryStatement{
  Query: &ast.Query{
    Query: &ast.FromQuery{
      From: &ast.From{
        Source: &ast.TableName{
          Table: &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 5,
            NameEnd: 6,
            Name:    "t",
          },
        },
      },
    },
    PipeOperators: []ast.PipeOperator{
      &ast.PipeLimit{
        Pipe:  7,
        Count: &ast.IntLiteral{
          ValuePos: 16,
          ValueEnd: 17,
          Base:     10,
          Value:    "1",
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
FROM t |> LIMIT 1
